title: Trade review 09 Nov: 21 results, 5 lessons
summary: 5 at T2, 6 hit T1, 4 failed at 30 days, 5 partial closes. Best: KOTAKBANK +8.33%; worst: GKSL −17.58%. 69 closed trades total +120.4%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Mon 9 Nov:** 5 trades closed at T2, 6 hit T1, 4 failed at 30 days, 5 partial closes (4 lost money).

A heavy day: 14 trades closed, nine of them 30-day exits from the early-October picks. Nifty was flat at 25,044.65 (+0.06%). All 69 closed trades now total +120.4% (average +1.7%), against +168.7% from 55 on Friday; today's closes netted −48.2 points. The open book is healthier: 14 of 33 running trades are below their buy price (26 of 46 on Friday), and the average of all 102 bought trades rose to +0.9%. Tomorrow (10 Nov) is an NSE holiday. The next 30-day exits are MOTISONS (−20.5%) on 11 Nov and ENGINERSIN (T1 booked, +1.8%) and URBANCO (T1 booked, −1.1%) on 12 Nov.

**Today's results**
- ✅✅ **DIVISLAB** (Retest, listed 2 Nov): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at ₹9,965.00 on 3 Nov, reached T1 and T2 the same day today, sold ₹10,634.13 after 6 days, +6.71%; worst dip −0.77%. It rose as much as 18.7% above the fill today, far past T2.
- ✅✅ **KOTAKBANK** (Retest, listed 19 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at ₹444.45 on 21 Oct, T1 was reported on 5 Nov, sold ₹481.48 today after 19 days, +8.33%; worst dip −3.77%. It traded 3.9% cheaper inside the entry window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹441.00 would have made +9.18%.
- ✅✅ **KROSS** (Retest, listed 26 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at ₹286.00 on 27 Oct, T1 was reported on 28 Oct, sold ₹308.98 today after 13 days, +8.03%, back from a −7.20% dip.
- ✅✅ **BANKINDIA** (Candle at support, listed 19 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at the zone top ₹134.15 on 22 Oct, T1 was reported on 5 Nov, sold ₹142.20 today after 18 days, +6.00%, back from a −7.83% dip. It traded 3.0% cheaper inside the entry window.
- ✅✅ **EMAMILTD** (Candle at support, listed 16 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at the zone top ₹371.98 on 19 Oct, T1 was reported on 3 Nov, sold ₹394.30 today after 21 days, +6.00%; worst dip −4.03%.
- ✅ **6 trades hit T1 today, all still open:** NMDC ₹68.80 → ₹70.87 in 3 days with no dip; LUPIN ₹1,958.03 → ₹2,016.77 in 4 days with no dip; ATHERENERG ₹1,774.60 → ₹1,850.21 in 6 days; RECLTD ₹293.70 → ₹303.63 in 10 days; PFC ₹322.75 → ₹332.43 in 17 days; KARURVYSYA ₹359.65 → ₹373.22 in 18 days, back from −9.33%. Four are candle-at-support picks and two are retests. Better prices were there for KARURVYSYA (10.3% below the fill), PFC (4.0%) and RECLTD (4.0%).
- 🟢 **GRANULES** (Candle at support, listed 6 Nov): bought: Filled inside the zone at ₹800.80 today (zone ₹782.05–805.51); now −0.20%, and it traded 1.9% lower than the fill today. A strong hammer on 4.0× volume, the high-volume group that often fails to fill. Its previous trade closed on Friday at −0.24%.
- ➖ **5 trades closed at 30 days after booking T1** (half at T1, half at today's close): MARKSANS +1.00%, BBOX −3.44%, ROSSTECH −3.88%, BALAMINES −5.25% and GMMPFAUDLR −7.08%. Four of the five lost money overall; all fell 8–18% after reaching T1. Three are pullbacks, one is a retest and one a breakout.
- ❌ **QUADFUTURE** (Retest, listed 8 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹508.00 on 9 Oct, best rise only 1.6%, closed at ₹421.95, −16.94% (worst −24.89%), 16% below its ₹502.40 support. The listing chart shows a stock that had rallied about 65% from an August low near ₹340 to a ₹567 high, a listing day on only 0.3× volume, and T2 (₹548.52) just under that ₹567 wall. Zone bottom only would have lost −16.01%, no help.
- ❌ **GKSL** (Retest, listed 7 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹189.18 on 8 Oct, best rise 4.0%, just short of T1 ₹198.38, closed at ₹155.92, −17.58%, 17% below its ₹187 support. It had the top score on its list (11), but the chart shows a climb of about 50% since August capped by a single huge-volume spike to ₹209.80, already fading at listing. Zone bottom only: −16.62%.
- ❌ **SYNCOMF** (Pullback, listed 7 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹23.27 on 9 Oct, best rise 2.9% (T1 ₹23.97 never touched), closed at ₹20.20, −13.19% (worst −18.87%). The chart shows it had nearly doubled from about ₹15 in July to a ₹27.50 spike, up 23% in the month, and it carried an ASM warning. Zone bottom only: −10.58%.
- ❌ **NRBBEARING** (Pullback, listed 5 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹519.02 on 8 Oct, best rise 2.6%, closed at ₹431.10, −16.94% (worst −18.63%), 14% below its ₹503.90 support. It had more than doubled since April, rose 19% in the month before listing, listed on 0.4× volume, and T2 (₹550.16) sat just under the ₹560 wall. Zone bottom only: −14.45%.

Plus 45 earlier, among them HDFCLIFE and GRANULES (6 Nov), GMRAIRPORT, M&M, SBILIFE, PREMIERENE, HINDALCO and MARUTI (5 Nov) and the seven 4 Nov closes. These 55 wins (44 at T2, 11 partial) made +272.1%; with the 14 failures (−151.6% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, SMLMAH −18.63% and GKSL −17.58%) all 69 closed trades total +120.4%. 7 of the 11 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (19): today NMDC, LUPIN, ATHERENERG, RECLTD, PFC and KARURVYSYA; 6 Nov CPPLUS; 5 Nov SUNDARMFIN, IDFCFIRSTB, WAAREEENER, TMPV, TATAPOWER and ENGINERSIN; 4 Nov ASTRAL; 2 Nov ONGC; 28 Oct PNGSREVA and ESCORTS; earlier LANDMARK and URBANCO. 4 of these 19 are below their buy price (ASTRAL, ESCORTS, PNGSREVA, URBANCO).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners still 16 of 23:** No new ones tonight. 15 of the 23 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 93% vs 81% as listed: 12.6 points (the bar is 15). Its 83 closed trades made +147.0%, against +120.4% from 69 as listed, with 19 losing trades against 18.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.5% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 82 closed trades made +181.3% with 14 losing trades, and its average closed trade is +2.6% against +1.7%. It is the best of the four rules on money, but it clears neither fixed bar yet.
- **Near misses: the real picks caught up on T1:** 77 of the 105 room-filter near misses reached T1 (73%), the same as the real picks (74 of 102, 73%) after today's six T1 hits; on T2 they still lead, 51% vs 43%. None is 30 days old yet, so none can have failed; their money can be compared from about 13 Nov. No retest setups have been logged since the change.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.2% (closed and open), against +2.7% for the other 71. 9 of the 14 failures were retests (QUADFUTURE and GKSL today), and their 18 closed trades net −63.9%, even after three retest T2s today (+23.1%). Off the list since 4 Nov. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** Picks that rose 5% or more in the month before listing: 38 trades, 11 of the 14 failures, average −3.1%, and their 27 closed trades net −94.1%. Picks that rose less: 64 trades, 3 failures, 33 at T2 (52%), and their 42 closed trades made +214.5%. All four of today's failures rose 6–23% in the month before listing. This uses my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change yet. (new)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 35 of 41 bought reached T1 (85%) and 22 reached T2 (54%); their 24 closed trades made +125.4% with 2 failures, and they have the shallowest dip (−4.2%). This replaces 'pullbacks reach T1 most often', now dropped: pullbacks' 22 closed trades made only +45.6%, with 6 losing money (SYNCOMF and NRBBEARING failed today). (new)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 16 of 23 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 15 of the 23 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys are often close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** Its near misses now match the real picks on T1 (73% each) and lead on T2 (51% vs 43%). None can fail until mid-November. (weakening)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 14, 57%), and those that fill dip −9.0%. F&O stocks reach T2 about twice as often as cash stocks (57% vs 29%) and dip far less (−3.4% vs −11.3%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. The closest candidate is buying at the next day's open: the most money of the four rules (+181.3% vs +120.4%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2. The run-up lesson is new tonight and rests on my own 5% split, so it needs a second review and a fixed group in the tracker first. The room-filter lesson weakened today, and its money comparison waits for about 13 Nov.

**🐞 Bug check:** nothing found. 102 bought = 44 at T2 + 11 partial + 14 failed + 33 running; T1 hit 74 ≥ T2 hit 44; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit; no price revisions against Friday's log. Closed trades stayed frozen (the scan now keeps them that way), the partial-win fix is scoring today's five partial closes correctly, and LIQUID1 is still +0.46%.
